biotools.summary: danRerLib is a Python package designed for zebrafish transcriptomics researchers. It provides tools for gene ID mapping, orthology mapping, and functional enrichment analysis, leveraging human-annotated functional annotations to overcome limitations in zebrafish-specific data.
